gen-press-start-2p-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a single ribbon with counters that breathe open, a geometric foil to the pixel-chunky fun of Press Start 2P. And the body text can sit a notch larger than you'd expect, since the retro heading carries the personality.
gen-righteous-fs-amulya: Amulya keeps its curves generous and modern, with a low-key stroke contrast that never fusses. But Righteous is the loud one, a rod-bent display face whose bowls fill the line, and the sans can stay at a modest size beside it.
gen-righteous-fs-chillax: Chillax reads loose and relaxed, its sans-serif lines wandering like spaghetti with curves that lift off before closing the loop. Righteous stands over it, tall and commanding, and the two make a playful, confident team.
gen-righteous-fs-plein: Plein reads reliable and clean, its sans-serif curves flowing through a clear channel into each round letter, with little thick-to-thin shift. Righteous towers over it with bowls that fill the line.
gen-righteous-fs-spline-sans: Bowls that fill the line and a single rod-like width give Righteous its commanding, fun swagger. Spline Sans follows in sans-serif, approachable and contemporary, with wide gaps where curves meet stems and a lowercase of moderate height.
gen-righteous-fs-synonym: Dependable, that's Synonym, a plain sans stripe of constant ink. Its curves open generously, so a long stretch of text moves smoothly beneath Righteous, whose steel-rod letters stay loud and fun up top.
gen-righteous-gf-aclonica: Righteous bends thin steel rod into every letter, steady as a technical pen, with bowls that fill the line. Aclonica is the stretched, deep-bellied sans for running text; Righteous is for shouting.
gen-righteous-gf-allerta: Allerta reads neutral and loose, its sans-serif letters spaced wide with a prominent x-height that keeps lines easy to follow. Righteous bends tubing-like curves into bold display shapes while Allerta does the quiet work.
gen-righteous-gf-alumni-sans: Righteous looks like rope-thin steel rod bent into letters, with no thick or thin parts anywhere. Alumni Sans feels clean and approachable beside it, with a smooth, modest weight gradient and a wide-open c.
gen-righteous-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Chunky tubing meets tight text. Alumni Sans Pinstripe packs its oversized lowercase into a close word texture, and Righteous, with bowls filling the line, takes the commanding role while the sans can run a size up.
